record.name: Twilio
record.one_liner: Twilio provides developer APIs and communication building blocks for messaging, voice, email, and authentication, using Account SID and Auth Token credentials.

auth.notes: Uses an Account SID and Auth Token to authenticate API calls via helper libraries or HTTP.

access.notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial with no credit card required and obtain API access immediately.

api_surface.notes: Provides REST APIs and official server-side helper libraries/SDKs for multiple languages.

mcp.notes: Mentions securing AI agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflows by granting scoped access to agents acting on behalf of users.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (api_key) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)
